title: N7 synthesis and capital allocation
scope: Synthesis of F1v2, F2, F3 dev verdicts and capital allocation across the surviving F-strategies. The allocator supports risk_parity, min_variance and equal schemes.

input_strategies.title: F3 vol-targeted trend ensemble on the panel

allocation.note: All three F-strategies are falsified on the desk gates. Risk_parity caps any negative-Sharpe weight to zero and re-balances the rest; with no positive-Sharpe strategy present, the allocator returns the equal-weight fallback (each survivor at 0).

decision.reason: F1v2, F2 and F3 all fail Sharpe 0.8, DSR 0.95 or DD -0.35; capacity is 0 USD in every case. No paper, no holdout, no live, no key, no order.
